scope: Turn the project opening area into a compact task strip
limitations: Headless WebKit with isolated observations. Native OS input, assistive technology and Rust command integration were not exercised.

welcome-desktop-dark.png.task: Choose a project or folder while keeping current activity visible.
welcome-desktop-dark.png.observations: The folder actions and four labeled activity counts fit a compact opening strip. Setup guidance is discoverable through its native disclosure. The project list moves upward by roughly one row of content; counts remain readable, zeros explicit, focus visible, and no controls overlap in either appearance or size.
